question: 写一条 SQL 查询：统计每个城市的订单总金额，只显示总金额超过 1000 的城市，按总金额降序。
check: SELECT c.city, SUM(o.amount) AS total FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer=c.id GROUP BY c.city HAVING SUM(o.amount)>1000 ORDER BY total DESC
